e: Postdoc starting Fall 2027 in the high-energy theory group of the Leinweber Institute for Theoretical Physics (SM/BSM, astroparticle physics and cosmology, strings, QFT, amplitudes, gravity); applicants are also considered for Leinweber Postdoctoral Fellowships, with a research and travel budget. No citizenship restriction stated.
